title: Sheep holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sheep fluffy body -->
  <g fill='#f4f1e8'>
    <circle cx='40' cy='55' r='14'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='55' r='14'/>
    <circle cx='49' cy='44' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='49' cy='66' r='13'/>
    <circle cx='33' cy='46' r='10'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='46' r='10'/>
    <circle cx='33' cy='64' r='10'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='64' r='10'/>
  </g>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='38' y='70' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#3d3a35'/>
  <rect x='54' y='70' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#3d3a35'/>
  <rect x='38' y='80' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#605a52'/>
  <rect x='54' y='80' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#605a52'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='34' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#3d3a35'/>
  <!-- fluffy top -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='23' r='6' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='23' r='6' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='21' r='6' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='28' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3d3a35' transform='rotate(-20 34 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='28' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3d3a35' transform='rotate(20 64 28)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#1a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#1a1a1a'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='40' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a8478'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='40' r='1' fill='#1a1a1a'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='40' r='1' fill='#1a1a1a'/>
  <!-- heart held in front -->
  <path d='M49 58 C49 55 44 52 42 55 C40 58 42 61 49 66 C56 61 58 58 56 55 C54 52 49 55 49 58 Z' fill='#e8433f'/>
  <!-- tiny hooves holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='60' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#605a52'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='60' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#605a52'/>
</svg>
